name: apple-notes
description: Safely search, read, create, update, move within one account, and explicitly delete Apple Notes by stable ID.

interface.shortDescription: Read and safely edit Apple Notes through a native local bridge.
interface.longDescription: Browse Notes with explicit scan limits, read plaintext or HTML by stable ID, and perform context-checked plaintext creates, attachment-safe full-content updates, same-account native moves, or explicitly reconfirmed deletes through a bundled Notes.sdef-backed JXA bridge.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-notes to safely find or manage a note by stable ID, with folder-context checks and plaintext write previews.
